definitions.timing: first actual ENGAGEMENT_FIRED -> directive ancestry -> COMMAND_DECIDED -> same node/trackReceivedAt/jobId; same branch approval interval union

definitions.wait: residual time from track processing to linked decision after same-branch approval intervals; no physical/procedural causal attribution
definitions.caps: timing disabled if any trace/flow/C2 channel truncates; population outcomes remain global
